'''Matcha Flavoured 1.02''', the "Tutorialisation Hotfix", is a hotfix published on July 26, 2026, the same day as [[Matcha Flavoured 1.01|1.01]]. It made the early game easier to follow by rewording and rearranging the Tutorial [[Advancements|advancements]] and fixing several early recipe unlocks.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.02|quote=I just wanted to try and make tutorialisation easier.}}</ref>

== Additions ==
* A fishing [[Advancements|advancement]].

== Changes ==
* [[Steel Alloy|Steel]] takes less time to blast.
* The steel advancement was reworded to explain how steel is made.
* The campfire, food and warding weapon advancements were reworded.
* The advancement tree was rearranged to make the order of progression clearer. See [[Progression]].
* [[Packed Mud|Packed mud]] is crafted from short dry grass instead of tall dry grass, which is cheaper.
* Fortune affects [[spawner]]s. This was reverted in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.03|1.03]].

== Fixes ==
* The "Two in One" advancement works.
* Fixed a brick duplication bug.
* Using a hoe on grass drops wheat seeds (now [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]]).
* Lapis lazuli unlocks the blue dye recipe.
* The chest recipe unlocks properly.
* The old [[Sack|shulker box]] recipe was removed, and the correct one unlocks.
* [[Malachite]] unlocks when calcite is obtained.
